title: A session with a registered fan-in wait shows as idle instead of Waiting
outcome: A root session that ends its turn with a wait the host holds (a delegation wait, a test-run wait, or a carried background gate) shows Waiting in the session inventory and UI, distinct from idle, with what it awaits and since when; a session with no such wait still shows idle.
acceptance: When a root session has finished its turn and the host holds at least one of its waits — a delegation wait (termal_resume_after_delegations), a test-run wait (termal_resume_after_test_runs), or a background full gate the host is carrying for it — termal_list_sessions and the UI show it as Waiting, not idle, until every such wait settles, is consumed or is cancelled; a test covers each of the three kinds.

The Waiting display gives a concise reason: the wait kind, what is outstanding (the count of delegations or runs, with their labels where the wait records them, or the carried gate's worktree), and when the wait started.
When the last wait settles or is cancelled, or the session resumes for any other reason, the status leaves Waiting with no manual refresh; a test shows it.
A session that has finished its turn and holds none of these waits still shows idle; a test shows it.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree.
